_meta.status: PILOT - D-032 recipe. Not registered in CLAIMS.md, not on the site.
rules: Ad account spends in US dollars (tested by CPM: naira accounts show CPMs of 500+)
The study's per-group report reconciles with Meta's reported spend, so group costs add up to the total
At least $500 of advertising and at least 200 qualified respondents
Recruitment waves only: baseline or single-wave studies. Follow-up waves re-contact people and are excluded
Studies that fed one survey at the same time are combined: spend summed, respondents counted once
The targeting can be stated in a sentence, and it did what it said

definitions.qualified_respondent: a person counted toward one of the study's quota groups: they are in the targeted group and completed the screening (the study's own quota rule, e.g. answered through to the phone-number question). Taken from the study's latest optimisation report (FACEBOOK_ADOPT current_participants).
definitions.ad_cost: Meta-reported advertising spend (per-group lifetime_spent, which reconciles with Insights) / qualified respondents. Excludes incentives, the survey platform and our fee.

terms.whole_state: ads shown to people Meta places anywhere inside the state's official boundary
terms.radius_area: a pin Meta lets an advertiser drop on the map, with a radius of 1-80 km (Marketing API custom_locations). 'Inside the radius areas' and 'outside them' are the two sides of that line. Never 'circles' (too plain, per Nandan) and never urban/rural (official definitions vary; the targeting rarely matches them)
terms.qualified_respondent: someone in one of the study's quota groups who completed the screening questions

study.design: wave 1 (the recruitment wave) of a two-wave panel survey, 'Pakistan HPV Panel Measurement'; wave 2 re-contacted respondents from Oct 2025 without ads and is not part of this
study.ad_days_note: spend on 15 of the 17 calendar days 28 Aug–13 Sep; none on 2 Sep and 9 Sep
study.eligibility: cares for at least one girl aged 9–17 (screened in the survey; others are ended)
study.quota_rule: in a place × gender group (from the ad clicked) and answered the education question, the last question of the wave-1 survey
study.quotas: Place (7 sets of radius areas: 4 in Karachi, Hyderabad, around Sukkur, around Larkana) × Gender: 14 groups. Target shares 9.8% per men's group, 4.2% per women's group

country_totals.definition: distinct inference_data.user_id across the 4 current-platform Pakistan studies; includes a handful of team test accounts (about 25 ids also appear in studies in other countries, each once)
country_totals.note: coverage.json (Aug 2026) gives PK 18,830; the difference is presumably older-platform respondents, not checked

checks: per-group spend sums to $4,444.25, exactly Meta's reported spend (recruitment_data_events)
targeting identical in all three saved strata configs (27 Aug, 3 Sep, 10 Sep 2025); the first was saved the day before ads started
2 test entries before ads (21 and 27 Aug, no ad metadata); every other respondent arrived during the ad window
10,947 of 11,080 people were new to Virtual Lab; 133 had been in pakistan-hpv-bil-survey-july-2025 (a different survey, July 2025) and came back through these ads
report counts match inference_data within 2 per group (report of 13 Sep 22:31; last data 13 Sep 20:44)

pins land on the cities and towns their labels name (nearest Natural Earth / GeoNames places); district boundaries NOT checked, since no reliable polygons for Karachi's districts were at hand. The Sukkur set spreads 58 km, toward Pano Aqil and south of Khairpur Mir's. 4 Karachi pins sit just off Natural Earth's coastline (Korangi coast), a boundary artefact
strata_note: Stratum ids label the four Karachi sets as districts (Central, East, West, Malir). The 1 km sets overlap each other and the 4 km 'Malir' set (overlaps above), and cross district lines, so the page pools them as Karachi. 'Sukkar' is the study's spelling of Sukkur.

excluded_for_review.note: Whole provinces (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan, ICT) × gender, 9–15 Jul 2025, 1,506 qualified for $0.19 each in the report. The only province-vs-province comparison in Pakistan; would be worth a page if the $500 rule were relaxed. Qualification rule differs from the panel's.

reasons: targeting not as stated: the 'urban' groups target Meta city 1796084 Islamabad (ICT) but the 'rural' groups exclude a different key, 1796082 Islamabad (Punjab), so Islamabad is in both; 'Kotli' is listed under Islamabad Capital Territory
excluded_for_review.note: Inside 14 city radius areas of 25 mi vs the rest of Pakistan, 27 Apr – 2 May 2024. Different ad account (1342820622846299).

reasons: same survey as pgp-polio-pakistan a month later; 714 of its 1,288 people are that study's respondents
